reasons.specificity: The inventory accurately distinguishes the thesis-bearing religion mapping from supporting mappings of money as key, optionality, entrepreneurial mediation, myth cycles, machinery, and addiction.
reasons.anchoring: Nearly all quoted expressions occur verbatim and support their assigned relations, though several findings display visibly truncated anchors rather than complete quotations.
reasons.non_obviousness: It usefully identifies the negative tertium comparationis, class limits on Vermögen, the difference between timeless and cyclical myths, and the hierarchy between governing and illustrative mappings.
reasons.coherence: The reading, inventories, and findings consistently attribute claims, but the appended scope assessment awkwardly declares review dimensions inconclusive while simultaneously reporting complete coverage.
reasons.usefulness: The two tables provide a strong text-open guide to expressions, transferred relations, argumentative implications, competing theories, and explicit limits.
reasons.hallucination_risk: Claims remain closely bounded to Deutschmann’s formulations and clearly mark proposals and conditional conclusions, with only minor interpretive compression such as calling religion an internal organizing form.

score.one_line: A highly accurate and discriminating mapping inventory whose main weakness is the contradictory, largely unhelpful scope-assessment boilerplate.
